determinism_note_zh: 本文件不含时间戳；相同输入必产生逐字节相同的输出。
determinism_note_en: This file carries no timestamp; identical inputs reproduce it byte for byte.

checks.description_zh: 协议恰好包含六个运行状态
checks.description_en: The protocol declares exactly six operating states

checks.description_zh: 所有状态转移的起点和终点均为已声明状态
checks.description_en: Every transition starts and ends at a declared state

checks.description_zh: 每个非终止状态都有至少一条外出转移
checks.description_en: Every non-terminal state has at least one outgoing transition

checks.description_zh: 已准入、运行中、安静态都可以进入已暂停
checks.description_en: admitted, live and quiet can each transition to paused

checks.description_zh: 已暂停既能回到申报重审，也能直接交接退出
checks.description_en: paused can return to proposed for re-review or exit via handed_over

checks.description_zh: 运行中与安静态可以双向切换
终止状态（已交接）没有外出转移
checks.description_en: The terminal state handed_over has no outgoing transition

checks.description_zh: 进入运行中必须满足四项运行门：人工责任、非AI后备、停机动作、恢复证据
checks.description_en: Entering live requires all four gates: human duty, non-AI fallback, shutdown action, recovery evidence

checks.description_zh: 四个时间带无缝且不重叠地覆盖 24 小时
checks.description_en: The four daily bands cover 24 hours with no gaps and no overlaps

checks.description_zh: 约束图层中恰好有十二个场景节点
checks.description_en: The constraints layer holds exactly twelve scenario nodes

checks.description_zh: 十二个场景节点的责任角色、停止条件、非AI后备、恢复证据与所属场地字段全部非空
checks.description_en: All twelve scenario nodes carry non-empty responsibility, stop, fallback, recovery and yard fields

checks.description_zh: 三座夜班场存在且每座至少承接一个场景节点
checks.description_en: All three night yards exist and each hosts at least one scenario node

checks.description_zh: 阶段一在分期图层中承诺零永久新建（new_permanent_construction=false）
checks.description_en: Phase 1 declares zero new permanent construction in the phasing layer
